# Variable `SDKTARGETSYSROOT`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The full path to the sysroot used for cross-compilation within an SDK as it will be when installed into the default SDKPATHINSTALL.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SDKTARGETSYSROOT)
